race.comment: DREAM TO DANCE (1) was out of the money two back at Menangle. Turned in a better run last time out when third over 1609m at Newcastle, beaten 13 metres. A nice draw on the front line should ensure a cosy run. Tackles a similar assignment and she can find winning ways. BO DUKE NZ (9) scored at Newcastle two runs ago before having his colours lowered when sixth at his latest appearance over 1609m at Newcastle, beaten 10 metres. Will enjoy a pretty soft run from this draw, with the sprint lane to play a big role. Meets a similar line up and he is capable of another bold performance. LETSTACOBOUTIT (7) is on the radar after his last-start sixth over 1660m at Parkes two weeks ago. SYENITE (8) was in the money two starts ago then things went amiss last start when he broke following interference and finished a distant last over 1720m at Young. The driver has some work to do again from this wide starting position. Only needs to enjoy an uninterrupted passage to be in the money.
